text:
Rosa (Marketing Ops): Noticing a backlog — ~40 leads stuck in HubSpot with owner=null for ~45m. They never hit the SDR queue. Anyone seeing this?
Ethan (RevOps): I see the same in the router metrics, spike at 1719012300. Quick look: mapping-service returned 503 for ~90s.
Priya (Growth): did we push anything to mapping or enrichment last night?
Rosa (Marketing Ops): only a small HS property add for campaign_attribution. Shouldn't affect owner mapping.
Ethan (RevOps): found the deploy that bumped the cache library. TTL calc used signed int and produced negative TTL for a few seconds after cold start. Mapping service responded with 502s and our router has `reject_unmapped=true` so leads were routed to Needs Review.
Marta (SDR lead): we had two SDRs manually claim a couple but most didn't appear in the fallback pool.
Ethan (RevOps): mitigation plan: (1) flip `reject_unmapped=false` so leads go to fallback_pool; (2) invalidate mapping cache cluster-wide; (3) run a targeted backfill for leads created in the 10m window.
Rosa (Marketing Ops): can we also add an obvious HS view filter for "fallback_pool" so ops can triage?
Ethan (RevOps): will push HS view update. Also adding a short processing gate to the backfill: only process if enrichment_ts >= now()-3600 to avoid re-triggering old leads.
Priya (Growth): thanks — also will pause nurture sends for that cohort until owners confirmed.
ops-bot: mapping-service v1.8.7 restarted by Ethan at 1719012405.
Ethan (RevOps): cache invalidated at 1719012410, router config toggled at 1719012415. Kicking backfill job now. SQL I used to find affected leads:
```
SELECT hs_id, created_at FROM inbound_leads WHERE created_at BETWEEN to_timestamp(1719012240) AND to_timestamp(1719012460) AND owner IS NULL;
```
Rosa (Marketing Ops): paste the list when job completes so I can update the HS saved view and ping SDRs.
Marta (SDR lead): SDR channel alerted. We'll triage fallback_pool while backfill runs.
Ethan (RevOps): backfill finished at 1719012540 — 41 leads moved to fallback_pool, 12 assigned after mapping repopulated.
Rosa (Marketing Ops): great. Action items: (A) add a canary that checks mapping-service unmapped rate > 3% over 3m, (B) add runbook step to toggle `reject_unmapped`, (C) add safe-backfill gate (enrichment_ts).
Priya (Growth): I'll coordinate the nurture hold and follow up with a short note for postmortem.
Ethan (RevOps): will open PRs for the canary + runbook.
Marta (SDR lead): leaving a triage note in the SDR handbook. Thanks team. :raised_hands:
